metadata.video_review: Original official YouTube storyboards at 5-second sampling visually inspected for route order and turn signs; not full-resolution continuous playback or audio transcription. Time windows are rough evidence locators, NOT turn timing instructions.
metadata.geometry_basis: OSM directed road/carriageway centrelines selected by official map and video turn topology. Exact U-turn arcs and stop/merge stations absent; no lane offsets invented.
metadata.license: OSM-derived geometry: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. Official video/PDF remain copyrighted source references and are not bundled as game textures.
metadata.lane_warning: Some currently split one-way Dongil-ro ways retain lanes=6/8 likely inherited from former two-way roads. Preserve raw tag, do not interpret as 6/8 lanes per carriageway or multiply blindly. Actual individual lane widths/assignments unverified.
metadata.width_policy: No physical pavement width supplied where absent. OSM tag lanes is source data, not validated road survey; rendering lane widths and traffic offsets must be marked estimates.
